Le maté est une infusion des feuilles de:
Maté is an infusion of yerba maté leaves (Ilex paraguariensis). It tastes bitter, earthy and herbal, somewhere between coffee and green tea.
The caffeine content varies from leaf to leaf, so Voltiz combines a maté extract (3.8% of the recipe) with caffeine (1.3%) for a precise dose in every gum.

Pendant la journée, une molécule appelée:
During the day, a molecule called adenosine builds up in the brain and slows nerve activity: it is what gets you ready for sleep.
Caffeine reaches the brain through the bloodstream and takes adenosine’s place on its receptors, without activating them.
Each Voltiz gum contains 40 mg. A serving of 2 gums provides 80 mg.
